title: Trace the serving path through dependency failure
description: Switch scenarios to see which stages consume the request deadline, which controls isolate failure, and what the caller receives.

nodes.label: Product caller
nodes.detail: Sends a versioned request with an end-to-end deadline and handles success, fallback, abstention, or explicit failure.

nodes.label: Inference gateway
nodes.detail: Authenticates, validates, rate-limits, rejects expired work, and routes only traffic that the serving tier can accept.

nodes.label: Feature service
nodes.detail: Returns timestamped features compatible with the requested model or an explicit stale, missing, or unavailable status.

nodes.label: Model runtime
nodes.detail: Batches compatible requests, executes the pinned model, and sheds load before memory or queue growth breaks every request.

nodes.label: Decision policy
nodes.detail: Applies thresholds, uncertainty handling, product constraints, and the approved fallback for this decision class.

nodes.label: Fallback store
nodes.detail: Provides a cached, heuristic, smaller-model, or abstention response without calling the failed dependency again.

nodes.label: Outcome stream
nodes.detail: Records prediction, fallback, exposure, and outcome join keys without delaying or determining the response.

scenarios.label: Healthy request
scenarios.summary: The request stays inside its deadline from admission through compatible features, model execution, and policy.
scenarios.result: The caller receives the model-backed decision and telemetry leaves asynchronously.

scenarios.label: Stale features
scenarios.summary: Feature freshness fails the model contract, so the request does not continue into inference with misleading inputs.
scenarios.result: The policy returns a declared fallback or abstains, preserving correctness over apparent availability.

scenarios.label: Runtime overload
scenarios.summary: The runtime reaches its queue or memory envelope and rejects work before tail latency becomes unbounded.
scenarios.result: Lower-priority work degrades through a safe alternative while admission control protects critical traffic.

scenarios.label: Runtime outage
scenarios.summary: The model tier is unavailable, but the fallback path remains independent and does not retry the same failed service.
scenarios.result: The product returns a bounded fallback, abstention, or explicit unavailable response according to error cost.

scenarios.label: Telemetry outage
scenarios.summary: Outcome logging is unavailable while the prediction and policy path remains healthy.
scenarios.result: Inference continues; bounded local buffering or loss is visible but cannot delay the caller.
